title: North Sentinel Island analogy for hidden non-human observers

tellings.quote: And I've given the example of North Sentinel Island where India manages North Sentinel Island but doesn't land there. And in such a circumstance, there would be a fermy paradox among the natives of North Sentinel Island.

plain: India manages North Sentinel Island but never lands there, so the islanders could easily believe nobody else is out there. The researcher Eric Weinstein uses this as an example on the show. He says it would give the natives their own Fermi paradox, the puzzle of why, if others exist, we see no sign of them, and so suggests that non-human observers could be watching us in the same quiet way.
